title: James Kunstler: How bad architecture wrecked cities
summary: James Howard Kunstler's TED talk argues that American public spaces and architecture have become unworthy of care, damaging civic life. He presents suburban sprawl and car-first design as failures of the common good.
why: HN recommends it as an engaging introduction to the critique of car-centric design and bad architecture.

quote.text: Here's a far more engaging critique of car-first design by James Kunstler
